verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks for CloudConvert. The closest items are the Socket.io-based Socket API for real-time task updates and the Zapier integration. These are an adjacent push channel and a third-party automation tool, not webhooks a programmatic consumer can register and receive, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
